extracted.name: Crepes
instruction_lines: Mix egg, milk, sugar, salt, flour, and butter.
Put butter on a warm medium sized pan.
Put ¼ C of batter in pan, and swirl it around.
Cook until the top is dry, and the bottom is a little brown, and flip.
